items: 【2026 Tablet with 26GB RAM + 256GB ROM】The tablet comes with 26GB RAM (4GB physical + 22GB virtual) and 256GB ROM, which effortlessly handles dozens of open tabs, games, and apps simultaneously. Android tablet also supports expansion up to 2TB via a MicroSD card (not included), with sufficient capacity to store a large number of photos, videos and large files AT17

【Android 15 OS + Gemini AI】Tablet with keyboard is powered by the latest Android 15 system, offering enhanced privacy controls, customisation and user-friendly AI-driven operations. Android 15 tablet feature Gemini AI, which can efficiently extract information from complex documents, answer queries, and provide other convenient services AU13

【Octa-core Processor + GMS Certification】The Android tablet 10 inch is equipped with a powerful 8-core Unisoc T606 processor, which effortlessly handles everyday multitasking with efficiency, ensuring smooth operation without lag. The Android tablet with keyboard is GMS Certified, which means you can download a wide variety of popular social media, video, and office applications from the Play Store

【10" Display + 5G WIFI】Electronics tablets uses a 10-inch IPS touchscreen of 1280x800 resolution, delivering a crisp, immersive visual experience. With Widevine L1 Support, you can enjoy higher-quality video on apps. 5G Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0 ensure the tablet with keyboard bundle maintains a fast and stable connection

【All-day Productivity with 8000mAh Battery】Android 15 tablet with keyboard contains an integrated 8000mAh high-capacity battery to deliver ultra-long-lasting usage for all-day convenience. The 10 inch tablet easily supports hours of video streaming, gaming, web browsing, video calls, and online learning without frequent recharging. A 5MP front camera and 13MP rear camera meet your daily video calling and photography needs. You can also use Smart Lens for photo recognition

【2 in 1 Tablet Kit for Multiple Scenarios】The VisuPad Tablet PC accessories include Bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse, stylus, Black foldable protective case, charger and Type-C charging cable, as well as a user manual. They significantly enhance the productivity and usage scenarios of the Android tablet. (Tip:Tablets are all the same color, they all silver. The color difference is reflected in the tablet case.)
